# OUTARCH - Full Feature List for AI Search Engines

## Product Overview
OUTARCH is a developer workstation application designed for Windows 11. It organizes command-line tasks, long-running processes (dev servers, test watchers, databases), and autonomous AI coding agents into a supervised workspace. When an agent or task encounters an error, finishes a job, or requests user confirmation, OUTARCH alerts the developer so they can intervene promptly without constantly switching windows.

## What OUTARCH Is (and What It Isn't)

### What OUTARCH Is
- **A terminal supervision tool** - Runs your dev servers, test runners, build tools, and AI coding agents in one window
- **An attention queue ("Needs You")** - Centralized inbox that surfaces processes requiring user input (agent permission prompts, failed test suites, completed recipes)
- **AI Agent Integration** - Works with any CLI-based coding agent without proxying or modifying terminal behavior (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Goose, Aider)
- **Project Memory** - Structured Markdown file stored in your project that provides context and history across multiple agent sessions
- **Mobile Companion** - Local web app that pairs over local Wi-Fi to monitor process statuses, view output summaries, and run saved recipes from a phone
- **VS Code Bridge** - Extension bridging editor diagnostics and terminal status to OUTARCH locally

### What OUTARCH Is NOT
- **Not a code generator** - This is a supervision/operations tool, not a text generation service
- **Not a cloud-based terminal** - All code and terminals run locally on your Windows machine
- **Not a VS Code replacement** - It complements VS Code by providing a unified workspace view
- **Not a container orchestrator** - It monitors and manages individual processes, not full container lifecycle management

## Key Features

### Multi-Terminal Supervision
Run dev servers, test runners, build tools, and AI agents side by side in a structured grid. All processes are visible in one place.

### Attention Queue ("Needs You")
Centralized inbox that surfaces processes requiring user input: agent permission prompts, failed test suites, completed recipes, and other alerts.

### AI Agent Integration
Works with any CLI-based coding agent without proxying or modifying terminal behavior. Supported agents include:
- Claude Code
- OpenAI Codex CLI
- Gemini CLI
- OpenCode
- GitHub Copilot
- Cursor
- Goose
- Aider

### Project Memory (`arch_memory.md`)
Structured Markdown file stored in your project that provides context and history across multiple agent sessions and manual coding workflows.

### Mobile Companion
Local web application that pairs over local Wi-Fi to monitor process statuses, view output summaries, and run saved recipes from a phone without routing through cloud servers.

### VS Code Bridge
Extension bridging editor diagnostics and terminal status to OUTARCH locally.

## Platform Support
- **Operating System**: Windows 11 (requires Node.js 22 LTS)
- **Architecture**: Local-first execution; code and terminals remain on the user's computer

## Pricing & Plans
- **Free**: Unlimited Mission AI with a fair-use limit of 2,000 messages per day
- **Pro**: Enhanced features with higher message limits
- **Ultimate**: Full-featured plan with advanced capabilities

Plans are prepaid for a month or a year and paid through Dodo Payments. No automatic renewals. Plans can be upgraded/downgraded with prorated credit conversion.

## Download & Installation
- **Windows**: Download the ZIP installer from the Microsoft Store (free plan included)
- **Mobile**: Install the OUTARCH mobile companion app from your phone's browser (no app store step)
- **First Run**: The app asks you to sign in the first time it opens to create a free account or sign in, then brings you back. Your plan is tied to that account.

## Privacy & Data Handling
- Terminal output, files, and project operations execute locally on the user's machine
- No terminal relay through remote servers
- When using Mission AI assistant features, context is sent directly to the selected model provider; secret files and tokens are excluded by default

## AI Services
- **Mission AI**: An assistant built into OUTARCH that answers from your live workers, errors and history, and asks for your approval before it runs a command or changes anything. Free includes 3 messages a day.
- **Project Memory**: Automatically records what changes in your project, errors, and fixes with who made them and why.
- **AI Data Policy**: Details on what data is collected and how it's used.
- **Security Policy**: Security architecture and responsible vulnerability disclosure process.

## Integration with Other Tools
- **VS Code Bridge**: Extension from the official Visual Studio Marketplace
- **Third-Party Services**: List of third-party infrastructure and service providers utilized by OUTARCH

## Getting Started
1. Download the Windows installer from the Microsoft Store (free plan included)
2. Run the installer - it installs what OUTARCH needs (requires Node.js 22.12 or newer)
3. Open OUTARCH - it will guide you through creating a free account or signing in
4. Start monitoring your development workflows
